methods_quotes.q: To calculate yearly state prevalence rates, the numbers of adults with elevated BLLs from each state were divided by the state's annual employed population
The combined state numerators and denominators for each year were then used to calculate the national prevalence rate
Denominators were the annual employed population aged ≥16 years for the period 2005--2007 from the Current Population Survey
For adults with more than one BLL result in a given year, only the highest BLL was included in this report
